degree_rationale: Five offspring/births by which food disperses through the body — through breath onto the mind, through voice/speech, through the power-and-shame, through pleasure of intercourse, through bodily begetting. Treats natural distribution-mechanism of bodily generation.
direction_rationale: Inward bodily reception of food as fivefold output — reflective taxonomy of how nourishment becomes generative substance. North = inner processing.
grand_man_function: Natural bodily-output reception — the five paths of food becoming generation.
title: The Five Births by which the body brings forth
